questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the article’s main point?
options: Knowing about ratings, finding them and using them are different stages.
Hygiene ratings have replaced price and recommendations in food choices.
Online ratings have become the main source of information for customers.
Rules on displaying ratings have made customers behave in the same way.
questions.explanationZh: 全文用知晓、查找和决策影响三方面的数据说明：知道有标签、找到标签和用它来决定购买，是不同的环节，不能混为一谈。
questions.promptZh: 哪一项最能概括文章的中心观点？

questions.prompt: Who does the 86% figure for looking at a sticker describe?
options: All respondents aged 16 or over who took part in the survey.
Respondents who said an online search for a rating was easy.
Respondents who had checked a rating during the period asked about.
All respondents who said they had heard of the rating scheme.
questions.explanationZh: 86%的分母是已经查看过评级的受访者，不是全体受访者，也不是仅仅听说过该制度的人。第10句专门解释了这一点。
questions.promptZh: 查看贴纸的86%这个数字描述的是哪些人？

questions.prompt: Why would it be misleading to say that the other 71% found online searching difficult?
options: The online-search figure refers only to people who had already used a sticker.
The remaining answers included not looking for ratings and not knowing.
The 29% figure describes people who avoided a business without a sticker.
The online-search percentage was calculated only for businesses located in England.
questions.explanationZh: 29%觉得网上查找容易，不等于其余71%都觉得困难。第12句说明，其余选项还包括没有查找过以及不知道，不能把不同回答合并成“困难”。
questions.promptZh: 为什么说另外71%的人觉得网上查找困难会产生误导？

questions.prompt: What is the best-supported comparison of the 28% and 94% findings?
options: The figures suggest that existing display rules had reduced avoidance by making missing stickers less common.
The figures suggest that people who had checked ratings supported display more often than other respondents.
The figures may not be comparable because one covers rating-checkers and the other covers everyone who knew the scheme.
The figures suggest support for display was more common than reported avoidance among respondents familiar with the scheme.
questions.explanationZh: 28%和94%的分母都是听说过评级制度的受访者：前者报告曾因没有贴纸而避开商家，后者支持商家必须展示评级。因此，在同一知晓制度的群体中，支持展示的比例高于报告避开的比例。文章没有用这两个数字证明展示规定减少了避开行为，也没有比较查看过评级者与其他人的支持程度。
questions.promptZh: 对于28%和94%这两项调查结果，哪一种比较最有文章依据？

questions.prompt: Which summary best respects the survey’s timing, coverage and method?
options: The report describes self-reported choices throughout the UK in 2025, with some uncertainty remaining after weighting.
The report describes directly observed choices in three UK countries in 2025, with some uncertainty remaining after weighting.
The report describes self-reported choices in three UK countries in 2025, with some uncertainty remaining after weighting.
The report describes self-reported choices in three UK countries in 2026, with some uncertainty remaining after weighting.
questions.explanationZh: 调查在2025年进行，覆盖英格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰，不包括苏格兰；2026年是报告发表年份。行为数据来自受访者自述，并非研究者直接观察。加权改善了代表性，但没有消除抽样等不确定性。把这些信息合并起来，只有该概括同时准确保留了时间、范围和方法。
questions.promptZh: 哪项概括最符合这项调查的时间、覆盖范围和方法？
